method: Native Canvas alpha>=16, 8-connected components >=512 pixels locate whole bodies; group Y rows and sort X; transparent-seam midpoints define extraction bounds. Final bboxes include all alpha>=16 pixels in each reconstructed cell. No pixel edits, scaling or frame alignment.
correction: The earlier v1 18.81% fixed-cell occupancy CV includes neighboring-row fragments. It is not intrinsic body scale drift; this component-based measurement supersedes it.
